summary: Tech-spec is well-structured and template-compliant. Frontmatter is valid (created 2026-04-30, status draft, branch feature/recursive-insight, size L). All required sections are present and substantive: Solution, Architecture (with What we're building, How it works, Shared resources table), 9 numbered Decisions with Rationale + Alternatives, Data Models, Dependencies, Testing Strategy (size L, tests deferred per Decision 9), Agent Verification Plan (with Verification approach, Verification steps table, Tools required), 9-row Risks table, Acceptance Criteria (10 technical criteria), and 12 Implementation Tasks across Wave 1-3 + Audit Wave + Final Wave. Skill names match the catalog (code-writing, code-reviewing, security-auditor, test-master, pre-deploy-qa). Reviewer assignments match the default mapping for code-writing (code-reviewer, security-auditor, test-reviewer) and audit/QA tasks correctly use 'none'. Final Wave correctly omits Deploy and Post-deploy verification for this desktop macOS app. Wave-internal file conflicts: none detected (W1: AIProviderClient.swift / DocumentState.swift+WorkspaceManager.swift / GraphRAG.swift; W2: InsightSession.swift / index.html / WebViewBridge.swift+EditorView.swift; W3: WorkspaceManager.swift / ContentView.swift). WorkspaceManager.swift is touched in W1-T2 and W3-T7 but those are in different waves (sequential, no parallel conflict). Task count is 12 (under the 15-task threshold). These are 'major' findings per the brevity rule but are not blockers for approval.
